description: This file is a PHP class file defining an administrative controller for managing rewards associated with investments in a crowdfunding platform, including actions for editing rewards, listing reward contributions, and marking rewards as fulfilled or unfulfilled.

classes.name: RewardsSubController
classes.description: An administrative controller class for managing project rewards, including editing, listing, and fulfillment operations.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user is allowed to access this controller, restricted to master nodes.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing a specific reward associated with an investment, including processing POST submissions.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists reward contributions with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: fulfillAction
methods.description: Marks a reward as fulfilled for a specific investment.

methods.name: unfillAction
methods.description: Marks a reward as unfulfilled for a specific investment.
